test_title: PYST 18: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 14 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which major initiative was approved by the Indian government in May 2025 to strengthen the country’s defence capabilities?

options.text: Establishment of new army divisions along the northern border
Development of a fifth-generation twin-engine stealth fighter jet
Deployment of nuclear submarines in the Indian Ocean

solution:
The correct answer is __**Acquisition of new aircraft carriers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **May 2025**, the Government of India approved key defence proposals aimed at strengthening maritime security, including progress toward the **acquisition of new aircraft carriers**.
 
• The initiative is aligned with India’s objective of enhancing its **blue-water navy capabilities** and ensuring dominance in the **Indian Ocean Region (IOR)**.
 
• The approval is linked to long-term plans for the construction of the **Indigenous Aircraft Carrier–II (IAC-II)**, also referred to as **INS Vishal**.
 
• Aircraft carriers serve as **mobile airbases**, enabling power projection, maritime strike capability, and rapid deployment of fighter aircraft at sea.
 
• This move supports India’s strategic doctrine of maintaining a **three-carrier force structure** to ensure at least two carriers remain operational at any time.
 
• ***Hence, the correct option is 2.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India’s Aircraft Carrier Fleet**

 
 
• **INS Vikramaditya** – Commissioned in **2013**.
 
• **INS Vikrant (IAC-I)** – Commissioned in **2022**, India’s first indigenously built aircraft carrier.
 
• Planned: **INS Vishal (IAC-II)** – Proposed next-generation carrier with advanced capabilities.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance of Aircraft Carriers**
 
 
• Enable **air dominance** over maritime zones.
 
• Support **humanitarian assistance and disaster relief (HADR)** missions.
 
• Enhance India’s ability to counter emerging security challenges in the **Indo-Pacific region**.
 
 
 
• **Indian Navy Modernisation**
 
 
• Focuses on expanding indigenous shipbuilding under **Make in India** and **Atmanirbhar Bharat**.
 
• Aims to strengthen surveillance, maritime strike capability, and sea control operations.
